sampling_scope.method: Direct retrieval from allowlisted public occupational foundations and public employer job-board APIs selected by the discovery pass; no paid or metered search provider.

sampling_scope.dedup: job id + canonical url + normalized employer + normalized title
sampling_scope.label: sample counts describe the retrieved window only; not market prevalence

frequency_caveat: Posting frequency is not importance, proficiency, hires or employability; counts describe the retrieved sample only and are not market prevalence.

skip_rules.action: publish foundation/scope claims only; no demand claims for that occupation slice
query returns insufficient_evidence or unsupported_question with a bounded local research handoff; never a fabricated answer
trend language is rejected at challenge; paired comparable retrieval windows are required before any trend claim
